definition: The minimum speed an unpowered object needs at a point in a gravitational field to reach infinity, ignoring air resistance: $v_\text{esc} = \sqrt{\frac{2GM}{r}}$. It does not depend on the object's mass.

The speed of a body in a circular orbit around a much larger mass, where gravity provides the centripetal force: $v_\text{orbital} = \sqrt{\frac{GM}{r}}$, with $r$ measured from the centre. Lower orbits are faster.
